claims.text: Start with the first supplied picture exactly, end on the second supplied picture exactly, and transform between them with a slow visual dissolve.
Preserve the complete pixels of both endpoint pictures.

summary.text: A slow visual dissolve connects the complete first character reference sheet to the complete second dragon reference sheet, preserving both full layouts and caption bands at their exact endpoints.

description.text: The shot opens on the complete first character reference sheet, held exactly as supplied in a static wide view. The full vertical layout remains visible at once and uncropped: a rain-soaked night hero panel across the top, showing a lean black-clad figure with shaved-side dark hair and a small top knot standing centered on wet reflective paving between metal railings, with warm lit windows and blurred rain lights behind; a middle row of three full-body turnaround panels showing the same figure in a black collared jacket, cargo trousers and lace-up combat boots against near-black studio backdrops; and a bottom row of four close-up detail panels covering the face, jacket collar, hands and boots. Panel borders, caption bands, the figure's observed positions and the dark sheet background remain intact. Around the middle of the shot, a slow visual dissolve begins, softening the sheet into overlapping washes without panning, zooming, cropping, reordering or removing any panel. Cool night tones, warm amber reflections and dim frontal studio light remain readable as the image starts to blend, and the wet paving, metal railings and distant window glow stay in their original places while the first sheet begins to give way.
The complete first character reference sheet is present exactly as supplied, with every panel, border, caption band and the dark background intact and uncropped.
A slow visual dissolve begins, softening the first sheet into overlapping washes without camera movement or cropping.

The dissolve continues across the cut and completes into the complete second character reference sheet, held exactly as supplied in a static wide view. The entire layout remains visible at once and uncropped: a wide dark-volcanic hero scene above, where a large black dragon with pale swept-back horns, a spiny dorsal ridge, four clawed limbs, a long tail and membranous wings stands low on wet rock with its head dipped toward a shallow pool, misty crags and an ember-orange glow to the right; a second row of three full-body turnaround panels showing the same dragon with spread wings against dark studio ground; and a bottom row of four close-up panels detailing the head, wing membrane, clawed foot and scaled hide. Panel borders, caption bands, the dragon's observed positions and the dark sheet background remain intact. The final sheet resolves cleanly and holds to the endpoint, with cool gray haze, warm orange rim light and highlights on the pale horns and wet scales still legible. The wet rock, shallow water and fireside glow remain fixed within their panels as the overlapping washes clear, and no panel, caption band or border is cropped, reordered or removed.
The first and second sheets overlap as the dissolve carries across the cut, both layouts still uncropped.
The dissolve resolves into the complete second sheet, which holds to the endpoint.
